title: Schadenfreude in the Digital Public Sphere: A cross-national and decade-long analysis of Facebook news engagement
reasoning: The research explicitly categorizes and evaluates 'Moral or Ideological' and 'Religious' topics as primary domains for analyzing human engagement. It assesses the performance of Large Language Models in classifying posts into these moral and religious categories and explores the concept of 'justice-based schadenfreude' related to moral deservingness.
